# I. TAXONOMY DETECTION

## 1. Intersection table (OK)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab <- expand.grid(
  "Marker" = c("Bota","Sper01","ITS2","18S","REF"),
  "Level" = c("Family","Genus","Species"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fill community composition
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab$tax_list <- map2(
  config_tab$Level,
  config_tab$Marker,
  get_tax_list
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Split by level
# --------------------------------------------------

list_by_level <- config_tab %>%
  split(.$Level) %>%
  map(~ setNames(.x$tax_list, .x$Marker))

# --------------------------------------------------
# Merge eDNA markers
# --------------------------------------------------
list_by_level_edna <- map(list_by_level, function(x){

  edna <- unique(c(
    x[["Sper01"]],
    x[["ITS2"]],
    x[["18S"]]
  ))

  list(
    Bota = x[["Bota"]],
    eDNA = edna,
    REF  = x[["REF"]]
  )
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------
save( list_by_level,
  file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.list_by_level.RData")


```

```{r}
    override.aes = list(size = 10)
  ))+

  )
})
```

### Markov network

```{r}
# ==== Inventaires ==== 
inv <- list(
  REF = c("A","B","C","D"),
  Bota = c("B","C","D"),
  Sper01 = c("C","D","E"),
  ITS2 = c("D","E","F"),
  `18S` = c("F")
)

# ==== Markov ====

edges <- data.frame()

times <- names(inv)

for(i in 1:(length(times)-1)){
  for(j in (i+1):length(times)){
    
    a <- inv[[i]]
    b <- inv[[j]]
    
    edges <- rbind(edges, data.frame(
      from = times[i],
      to   = times[j],
      shared = length(intersect(a,b)),
      gain   = length(setdiff(b,a)),
      loss   = length(setdiff(a,b))
    ))
  }
}

nodes <- data.frame(
  name = names(inv),
  richness = sapply(inv, length)
)

library(igraph)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes)

V(g)$label <- nodes$richness
V(g)$label.cex <- 1

E(g)$label <- edges$shared


library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)

ggraph(g, layout = "kk") +  # ou "tree", "circle"
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = shared), alpha = 0.6) +
  
  geom_node_point(aes(size = richness)) +
  
  # labels internes (richesse)
  geom_node_text(aes(label = richness), color = "black") +
  
  # labels externes (T1, T2...)
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 repel = TRUE,   # 🔥 magique
                 fontface = "bold") +
  
  theme_void()

plot(g,
     vertex.size = nodes$richness * 10,
     vertex.label = nodes$richness,   # intérieur
     vertex.label.cex = 1.2,
     vertex.label.color = "black"
)


```

### New

```{r}


genet_family_OTU_nb <- function(genet){
  # Replace NA by Indet. (same as bota survey)
  for (l in c("family","genus","species")) {
    genet$motus[[l]][is.na(genet$motus[[l]])] <- "Indet."
  }
  
  # Select OTU
  otu_list <- select_tax(genet$motus, "family", "All")
  
  # # Apply otu filters
  # otu_list <- rlang::exec(apply_filters, otu_list, !!!filters) 
  
  # get otu_id
  otu_list <- otu_list %>% filter(!is.na(id)) %>% pull(id)
  
  # Replace : and - by . # (18S anomaly)
  otu_list <- gsub(":", ".", otu_list)
  otu_list <- gsub("-", ".", otu_list)
  
  # Select Reads from OTU_id
  reads_filtered <- genet$reads[, colnames(genet$reads) %in% otu_list, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Init
  reads_tax <- reads_filtered
  
  # Créer le vecteur d'espèces aligné avec les lignes
  tax_names <- genet$motus[["family"]][
    match(colnames(reads_filtered), genet$motus$id)
  ]
  
  # OTU by family
  OTU_nb <- table(tax_names) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename(Family = tax_names, n_otu = Freq)
  
  return(OTU_nb)
}
  
# Expantion des famille en OTU
expand_otu <- function(OTU_nb){
  
  OTU_nb %>%
    tidyr::uncount(n_otu) %>%
    group_by(Family) %>%
    mutate(OTU = paste0(Family, "_", row_number())) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(OTU, Family)
}

# Null Model
assign_growth_null <- function(otu_df, ref_df){

  gf_cols <- c("terrestrial","tree","treelet","liana","shrub",
               "vine","epilithic","parasite","hemi.epiphyte")

  fam_prob <- ref_df %>%
    group_by(Family) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(gf_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(gf_cols), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

  otu_df %>%
    left_join(fam_prob, by = "Family") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      growth_form = sample(
        gf_cols,
        size = 1,
        prob = c_across(all_of(gf_cols))
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(value = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = growth_form,
      values_from = value,
      values_fill = 0
    )
}

# Aggregation
aggregate_growth <- function(df){

  gf_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("OTU","Family"))

  df %>%
    group_by(Family) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(gf_cols), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(gf_cols)))) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(gf_cols), ~ .x / total)) %>%
    select(-total)
}

# Pipline génet réel
build_genet_obs <- function(genet){
  
  OTU_nb <- genet_family_OTU_nb(genet)
  otu_expanded <- expand_otu(OTU_nb)
  sim <- assign_growth_null(otu_expanded, ref_df = NULL) # pas utilisé ici
  
  aggregate_growth(sim)
}

# Bray Curtis Stat
T_stat <- function(x, y){

  sum(abs(x - y)) / sum(x + y)
}

# Stat Obervée
compute_T_obs <- function(genet_obs, ref){

  gf_cols <- intersect(names(genet_obs), names(ref))

  x <- colSums(genet_obs[, gf_cols])
  y <- colSums(ref[, gf_cols])

  T_stat(x, y)
}

# Permutation test
run_permutation <- function(genet, ref, n_perm = 10){

  OTU_nb <- genet_family_OTU_nb(genet)

  T_obs <- compute_T_obs(
    build_genet_obs(genet),
    ref
  )

  T_null <- replicate(n_perm, {

    otu_expanded <- expand_otu(OTU_nb)

    sim <- assign_growth_null(otu_expanded, ref)

    agg <- aggregate_growth(sim)

    T_stat(colSums(agg), colSums(ref))
  })

  p_value <- (1 + sum(T_null >= T_obs)) / (n_perm + 1)

  list(
    T_obs = T_obs,
    T_null = T_null,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

# Référence

  dplyr::select(-starts_with("habit.")) %>%
```

## 2. Random Forest

### A. Create

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# IMPORT DIV PATTERNS
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- BOTA --
bota_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10,
  Metric = "OTU",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "All"))

# -- Sper01 -- 
Sper01_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="Sper01", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# -- ITS2 --
ITS2_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="ITS2", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# ABIOTIC JOIN
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- ABIOTIC --
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,wetness,Al,K,Ca,Na,Fe,C,N,light) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N))

# -- BOTA --
data_pixel_bota <- inner_join(bota_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- Sper01 ---
data_pixel_Sper01 <- inner_join(Sper01_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- ITS2 ---
data_pixel_ITS2 <- inner_join(ITS2_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# RANDOM FORESTS
# --------------------------------------------------

# # -- BOTA --
# res_bota <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_bota)
# 
# # -- Sper01 ---
# res_Sper01 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_Sper01)
# 
# # -- ITS2 ---
# res_ITS2 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_ITS2)

## Random Forests 500*100
imp1 <- rand_for_IncMSE_rep(data_pixel_bota) %>% mutate(pattern = "Bota")
imp2 <- rand_for_IncMSE_rep(data_pixel_Sper01) %>% mutate(pattern = "Sper01")
imp3 <- rand_for_IncMSE_rep(data_pixel_ITS2) %>% mutate(pattern = "ITS2")

df_RF <- bind_rows(imp1, imp2, imp3)

# --------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------
save( df_RF,
  file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.df_RF.RData")
```

### C. Abiotic params correlation (OK)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# IMPORT
# --------------------------------------------------
abiotic_red <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,Ca,Al,K,C,N) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N,x,y))

# --------------------------------------------------
# CORRELATION MATRIX
# --------------------------------------------------

# Matrix
corr_mat <- cor(abiotic_red, use = "complete.obs")
  
# Long format
corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr_mat))
colnames(corr_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

# Triangle (upper only)
corr_df <- corr_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.numeric(Var1) <= as.numeric(Var2))

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

ggplot(corr_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(abs(Correlation) > 0.1, # select display corr
                               sprintf("%.2f", Correlation), "")),
            size = 3,
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    fill = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

```
